description: Start listing a new entity on NaN Mesh via AI conversation. BEFORE calling this: use nanmesh.entity.search to check if it already exists. Requires a verified human Clerk session; user_id alone and an Agent key cannot authorize this legacy conversation flow. Personal dots should use nanmesh.dot.publish_project/update_project for the existing agent catalog APIs. Returns a conversation_id. Then use nanmesh.listing.continue to describe the product.

owner_email.description: Product owner's email — required for claiming the listing

user_id.description: Legacy compatibility field; actual human identity comes from a verified Clerk session

name: nanmesh.listing.start
title: Start Product Listing
